newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says looking to build steel sales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says looking to build steel sales.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would seek to increase sales for its troubled steel unit, despite a flat outlook for the housing market, through import replacement.

International markets, especially in the Asian region, remained competitive but BHP would work to increase steel division exports and expand its network of operations in Asian and the U.S., the company said in its 1995/96 annual report.
"New technologies are being developed to support this strategy," BHP said. It did not elaborate on new technologies.
BHP Steel's profit for the year to May 31, 1996 fell 75.9 percent to A$153 million on sluggish domestic demand and lower prices.
In February, BHP restructured the division into four business built around its key production chains and markets.
